Plumbing added to an enclosed porch or addition can freeze from below.

blocks.h2: Where Pipes Freeze in Skokie Homes
blocks.body: In Skokie ranches and Cape Cods, pipes freeze where they run near the outside: kitchen sinks on exterior walls, laundry lines near a basement window, outdoor faucets and pipes in crawl spaces under additions. Insulating those spots and sealing drafts helps. On the coldest nights, open cabinet doors and let a faucet drip.

blocks.h2: Frozen Pipe Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: My kitchen faucet won't run in a cold snap. What should I do?
items.preview: Open the cabinet, open the faucet and warm the pipe gently.
items.answer: Open the cabinet doors, open the faucet and warm the pipe gently with a hair dryer. Never use an open flame. If it doesn't come back, call us.

items.q: How do I keep pipes from freezing?
items.preview: Heat, open cabinets and a slow drip on the coldest nights.
items.answer: Keep the heat on, open cabinets on exterior walls and let a faucet drip on the coldest nights.

items.q: Can you repair a pipe inside a wall?
items.answer: Yes. We locate the break and open only what we need.

items.q: Should I replace old galvanized pipe after a burst?
items.answer: If the burst pipe is galvanized and the rest of the system is the same age, it's worth discussing a larger repair or repipe.

items.preview: Yes, if a hose is left on.
items.answer: Yes, if a hose is left connected. Disconnect hoses before winter.

items.q: How much does burst pipe repair cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the break. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the pipe burst and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
